title: [finding] Armed rider clauses on pm:on-hold cards are 0-for-19: no dispatching seat runs the pre-dispatch trigger-file intersection
body:
Found by the triage seat's on-hold rider-clause audit (2026-08-19, ~16:47Z round, session `session_014qTKTqjme5Fp5BH9iRmy6t`); measured by a read-only verification pass over 12 flagged cards against origin/main.

## The measurement

Across the audited cards, "armed rider" holds — "the next PR touching file X carries this card's cheap fix as a declared rider" — observed their trigger files being touched **19 times with the rider carried 0 times**:

- #8331: `.github/workflows/lint.yml` touched 3× (PRs #9869, #9990, #10005) — rider never carried
- #8883: `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` touched 9× — rider never carried
- #8656: `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` touched 8×, 2× editing the Field builder itself — rider never carried
- #8984: 2 of 3 trigger docs touched (one PR landed ONE HOUR after the hold) — rider never carried
- objectui#4082: `ObjectGrid.tsx` touched 5× — rider never carried
- #9139: two dispatches intersected its trigger files without naming the card (its "must name this card" clause)

All six cards' riders were released to queue or re-stated this round; this card is about the MECHANISM, not those cards.

## Why this is a skills-lane finding

The opportunistic-restart mechanism is a maintainer-accepted design (2026-08-11): hold comments name trigger files, and seat posts carry a "check before dispatch" section so a dispatching seat intersects its card's file surface with held cards' trigger lists. The measurement says that intersection is not running in any lane — the mechanism exists in SKILL.md and in hold comments, but no seat's dispatch loop executes it. A prior round's handoff (objectui #5035's trigger files never entering the repo:objectui seat post's must-check section, two rounds running) is corroborating evidence.

## Directions for grading (skills seat self-triages this lane)

1. Make the intersection mechanical instead of behavioral: extend `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (or a sibling) to grep open `pm:on-hold` cards' trigger-file lines against the dispatch's file surface, so the dispatching PM gets the hit list as tool output instead of remembering a protocol step.
2. Or retire the rider mechanism honestly: if riders are 0-for-19, holds that depend on them should use plain Restart-when conditions the unlock scan can fire (this round already rewrote several that way).
3. Either way, the seat-post "派发前必查" section's real-world compliance is the thing to fix or delete — a written protocol step nobody executes is worse than none, because holds are priced assuming it runs.

Related: #8941 (unlock scan blind to comment-level Blocked-by — the sibling visibility gap, already tracked in this lane).
